research_roles.SECTOR_ROTATION_CONCENTRATED: higher-return challenger with explicitly accepted concentration risk
research_roles.SECTOR_ROTATION_INV_VOL: risk-adjusted challenger using the same selected sectors
research_roles.REGIME_ROUTED_SECTOR: fixed causal routing across bull/bear and high/low-volatility states

historical_development: positive excess return versus SPY at 10 basis points
positive median rolling three-year excess return
no single calendar year supplies more than half of cumulative excess return
results remain directionally acceptable at 20 basis points
forward_confirmation: positive net excess return versus SPY
no worse than 1.25 times SPY maximum drawdown
no strategy parameter changes during confirmation

interpretation: Historical dates through 2026-09-03 are development evidence because their outcomes were already observed. Only dates from 2026-09-04 onward can provide untouched confirmation for these candidates.
